title: Dynamics and geometry of the inner sub-parsec-scale jet in 3C 279 observed with the Event Horizon Telescope
authors: H. Müller, S. D. von Fellenberg, A.-L. Zeng, et al., including K. Chatterjee
description: Multi-frequency EHT observations resolve the inner jet of the blazar 3C 279. The study examines how its geometry and structure evolve across observing epochs.

title: Broadband multiwavelength properties of the archetypal blazar 3C 279 during the 2017 Event Horizon Telescope campaign
authors: G. Principe, J. C. Algaba, E. Aviano, et al., including K. Chatterjee
description: A multiwavelength campaign follows the changing emission of 3C 279 around the 2017 EHT observations. The study combines light curves and a broadband spectrum to investigate its jet.

title: GRMHD Simulations of Accreting Proto-Magnetars II: Implications for r-process Nucleosynthesis
authors: T. Prasanna, K. Parfrey, B. D. Metzger, et al., including K. Chatterjee
description: Simulations examine how disk–magnetosphere interactions change the mass and composition of proto-magnetar outflows. Reaction-network calculations explore the resulting production of heavy elements.
figure_alt: Temperature profiles and magnetic field structures in the simulations.

title: GRMHD Simulations of Accreting Proto-Magnetars I: Implications for Gamma-Ray Burst Jets and Energetic Explosions
authors: T. Prasanna, K. Parfrey, B. D. Metzger, et al., including K. Chatterjee
description: Axisymmetric simulations explore accretion onto strongly magnetized, rapidly rotating neutron stars. They show how disk interactions affect jet power, variability, and stellar spin evolution.
figure_alt: Angular magnetorotational instability quality factor in the simulated disk.

title: Relativistic Magnetohydrodynamic Simulations of Giant Magnetar Bursts
authors: K. Chatterjee, A. Philippov, A. M. Beloborodov, et al.
description: Relativistic simulations follow a magnetar eruption driven by surface shear. They capture magnetic reconnection, hot plasma ejection, and the formation of a confined fireball.
figure_alt: Simulation of the onset and evolution of a magnetar eruption.

title: Ring Asymmetry and Spin in M87*
authors: V. Bernshteyn, N. S. Conroy, M. Bauböck, et al., including K. Chatterjee
description: The study compares the brightness asymmetry of EHT images of M87* with simulated accretion flows. The comparison examines how observations constrain black hole spin in strongly magnetized models.
figure_alt: EHT images of M87* across three observing epochs.

title: Novel Polarimetric Analysis of Near-horizon Flaring Episodes in M87* in Millimeter Wavelength
authors: R. Emami, M. Liska, K. Chatterjee, et al.
description: Polarimetric simulations examine how a millimeter flare near M87* might be identified. The study explores the roles of black hole spin and magnetic structure in the resulting signals.
figure_alt: Simulated images of M87* before, during, and after a flare.

title: On the Universality of Energy Extraction from Black Hole Spacetimes
authors: K. Chatterjee, Z. Younsi, P. Kocherlakota, et al.
description: Three-dimensional magnetohydrodynamic simulations examine jet power in black hole spacetimes that deviate from Kerr geometry. They test the robustness of the Blandford–Znajek relation across those geometries.
figure_alt: Simulation rendering of black hole accretion and a magnetized jet.

title: Misaligned magnetized accretion flows onto spinning black holes: Magneto-spin alignment, outflow power, and intermittent jets
authors: K. Chatterjee, N. Kaaz, M. Liska, et al.
description: Simulations follow magnetically arrested accretion flows tilted relative to the black hole spin. They find inner-disk realignment at moderate tilts and intermittent jets at larger tilts.
figure_alt: Initial and final states of a tilted magnetized accretion flow.

title: Accretion Flow Morphology in Numerical Simulations of Black Holes from the ngEHT Model Library: The Impact of Radiation Physics
authors: K. Chatterjee, A. Chael, P. Tiede, et al.
description: The study compares black hole accretion simulations from the ngEHT model library. It examines how radiation physics changes the flow and its observational interpretation.
figure_alt: Accretion-flow diagnostics from the ngEHT model library.
